item.mistletoe.mistletoe.desc: An overlooked branch. The greater the life before it, the deeper the cut.
item.mistletoe.mistletoe.hint: Charge right click for the precise cut. Hold the special move key (V) for about a second to bloom.
item.mistletoe.dawn.desc: A branch beaded with dawn dew. It does not seek the kill; it only helps its wielder last a little longer.
item.mistletoe.dawn.hint: Charge right click to release First Light. On hit, gain brief Regeneration I.
item.mistletoe.first_snow.desc: A thin frost on the edge. No clever rules, only faster and denser cuts.
item.mistletoe.first_snow.hint: Charge right click to release Frost Blade: seven high-speed slashes.
death.attack.mistletoe_slash.player: %1$s was cut open by %2$s with mistletoe
death.attack.mistletoe_sacrifice: %1$s gave their life to the mistletoe
death.attack.mistletoe_godslayer: %1$s was pierced by the mistletoe's exception
commands.mistletoe.audit: Normal %s; enhanced SA %s; sacrifice %s; SA damage %s; super cost %s; super lethal %s; radius %s
